_comment: Hash-only held-out roster for CI. Derived from the PRIVATE roster by
scripts/gen_heldout_roster_hashes.py in track1-coding-private; contains no held-out
unit ids, canary GUIDs or file contents -- only their sha256 digests. A match proves
a public artifact IS held-out material; nothing here reveals what it is.
ARRAY LENGTHS ARE FIXED CONSTANTS AND CARRY NO INFORMATION. Every array is padded to
the size named in pad_targets with random decoys and sorted, so the count of entries
is not the count of held-out units and a decoy is not distinguishable from a real
digest. Do not infer a roster size from this file, and do not regenerate it by hand:
an unpadded array would disclose the size, and check_heldout_roster.py fails closed
if any array length does not match its declared target.
CI tier only: catches a held-out unit id, its canary guid in a card, or a byte-
identical held-out file committed here -- including the oracle under reference/.
It cannot see a GUID buried in prose or a near-miss copy; the full content scan runs
organizer-side against the real roster before anything flips public.
Regenerate whenever the sealed units change; both steps need the sealed roster.
